en.summary: Dry eyes feel gritty, burning or watery-paradoxically. NHS: blink breaks, humidify, and pharmacy lubricating drops may help — brands/doses are individual; this pack does not invent regimens. Urgent care for severe pain, sudden vision loss, light sensitivity with trauma, or chemical splash.
emergencyIf: Sudden vision loss or severe eye pain
seeDoctorIf: Contact lens wearers with ongoing irritation
doNot: Do not invent steroid eye-drop regimens
Do not ignore chemical eye injury

fr.summary: Œil sec: pauses clignement, larmes artificielles en pharmacie. Urgences si brûlure chimique, douleur sévère, baisse visuelle.

he.summary: עיניים יבשות: הפסקות מצמוץ, דמעות מבית מרקחת. חירום בכוויה כימית או כאב/ירידת ראייה.

ru.summary: Сухие глаза: перерывы на моргание, аптечные капли. Неотложка при химическом ожоге или сильной боли/потере зрения.
